|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">「兵員をエネルギー・シールドの外側に降下させろ。艦隊を展開して、一隻たりとも星系外へ逃がすな」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Death Squadron.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any system. Adds X to the total power of your starships at that system, where X = the number of your starships present. Your troopers and combat vehicles may shuttle to sites of the same system without spending Force.

'''Lore:'''
"Land the troops beyond the energy shield. Deploy the fleet, and let not one ship escape the system."

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese shuttles to sites of the same system; the English to related sites.
